bestBets.overview: Victorian visitor GRADIVUS finds himself in a winnable race at his first trip across the border. He has drawn the inside gate and is expected to handle the extra distance. KARMA QUEEN raced wide throughout at Port Augusta last time and stuck on okay to finish second. HASTA LA SILVER worked to the line fairly to finish fifth at Naracoorte when rising to 1430m. This race isn't strong, he can improve. BLACK HEX was placed at Murtoa two starts ago, but was disappointing at Warracknabeal last time. Watch market moves for the debutante WITTY DIVA.

raceTips.comment: Gradivus was specked at big odds first-up at Warracknabeal and draws an inside gate. Karma Queen ran OK behind Dirty Deal at Murray Bridge two runs back and then finished 3rd at Port Augusta last time. She gets her chance. Witty Diva debuts for Sarah Rutten. Her trial was only fair and she has jumped out since. She gets blinkers. Caesour’s Tomb ran an improved race when 4th behind Mahaler at Murray Bridge last start. Black Hex ran 2nd at Murtoa two runs back, beaten 4 lengths, and can improve on last time.

bestBets.overview: JUST COMET ran home well to finish fifth in a leader dominated race at Morphettville at her second run back from a break. She'll strip fitter again. ILLUSTRIOUS WARRIOR was placed in a maiden at Morphettville in May. He comes into this off the back of a 1000m Halidon trial win on August 27th. DON'T SAY DO (formerly trained by Rod Northam) is a newcomer to SA who was placed twice at the start of this campaign. Keep a close watch on market moves for her, as well as debutante AVIATION HEIRESS from the Sarah Rutten stable.

raceTips.comment: Just Comet was good running 2nd behind Sensational Secret at Murray Bridge and then 5th behind Super Wonder on the Parks at Morphettville. Brave Fortune was well beaten behind Like A Drifter before a spell and placed in a recent Mindarie Halidon trial behind Oliva Marie, who has won in town since. Grand Millesime was sent out an odds-on fav when 4th at Mildura last weekend. She draws out but gets her chance. Illustrious Warrior has ability. He was placed at Morphettville in May and won a recent trial ahead of his return. Stablemate Nic The Cash ran well at Naracoorte last time behind Angry Berdi. Aviation Heiress debuts for Sarah Rutten and the form out of its recent trial looks sound. Don’t Say Do is on debut for Stephen Theodore and has been placed at four of 10.

bestBets.overview: DECIMUS has had the benefit of two runs back from a spell and steps up to a more suitable trip now. This is easier and he handles all conditions, look for improvement. ON THE MAP was one paced in the run to the line at Naracoorte last time. The extra distance is a plus. FLYING SHELBY got the money at Coleraine three starts ago, then raced wide before tiring at his next outing. He failed to see out the 2000m trip last time so back to 1600m suits. HALLSTATT was good at Murray Bridge three starts ago. There haven't been any excuses for him at his past couple but he can improve in this company.

raceTips.comment: Hallstatt has been racing well and was 6th behind Final Countdown at Murray Bridge last time. On The Map was OK at Naracoorte last time when 5th behind Rhinestone Rory and draws well. Decimus can improve here from a middle barrier. Spelman was a Strathalbyn winner two runs back at big odds.

bestBets.overview: BLUE ISLES has finished in the placings in three of her past four runs. She has only managed to win one race to date but gets her chance to notch up another here. UNWIND is another who has been racing consistently without managing a win. WHISTLER GIRL finished just behind the placegetters at Casterton last start. SAZERAC got into the placings behind Hamner Springs two-back then went to Morphettville last time where she found the class too strong. ENCIPHERING was not disgraced when fourth over an unsuitable trip at Strathalbyn first-up. CHARLESFORT & AUSSIE PHAROAH are others with claims.

raceTips.comment: Blue Isles made good ground when 3rd behind Play Bouzouki at Murray Bridge and should give this a shake. Unwind is knocking on the door and was 4th behind Fantastic Host at Murray Bridge last time. Shalhavmusik was OK running 5th behind Final Countdown last start. Detoron is a watch after winning a trial by a big space on debut for a new stable.

bestBets.overview: ROB THE BANK kicked off his last campaign with a win over 1100m at Gawler. He was runner-up in a Strathalbyn jumpout on August 31st. There have been excuses for TWO KAY KLICK in both runs back from a break. MELISSA KATE has been around the mark in all five runs since winning at Casterton in July. She has won here and has drawn to get a good run from the inside gate. BOLTONOVA improved into the placings at Strathalbyn at his most recent run.

raceTips.comment: Melissa Kate has been placed at her past three and was good late running 2nd at Warrnambool last time. She draws the inside. Rob The Bank resumes and was around the mark last time in work, running 2nd at Horsham. She Sparkles is a winner at her only start here and was good behind Whiskey Tumbler at Strathalbyn two starts back. Boltonova ran well at Strathalbyn when 3rd behind Prince Kuro last start.

bestBets.overview: THE ICE CUTTER ran home well from back in the field to finish second to all-the-way winner Prince Kuro at Strathalbyn when resuming. He'll strip fitter for that and has a good second-up record. PRODIGAL LAD was placed behind Bellentia two starts ago. He disappointed as favourite at his most recent run, but this is easier and he can improve. JUST LIKE LISA hasn't managed a win since February 2025 but she has been racing consistently of late. AFFAIRE VUE has raced well when fresh in the past and could sneak into a place. LUNARSHOT got the money at Murray Bridge two starts ago.

raceTips.comment: Prodigal Lad was sent out fav when 7th behind Prince Kuro at Strathalbyn last time. Just Like Lisa continues to race well and was fav when on speed and 4th behind Forever Waiting at Naracoorte last time. Lunarshot was a Murray Bridge winner two runs back and draws a nice barrier. The Ice Cutter ran well first-up when 2nd behind Prince Kuro at Strathalbyn.

bestBets.overview: COSTLESS led them up at Morphettville last weekend before fading late to finish fourth. He'll find this easier and he has won here. NARALINGA made it two wins from his past three starts when he defeated Gusty Way at Naracoorte a fortnight ago. STARTIDE made good ground from back in the field to finish less than two lengths from the winner at Murray Bridge when resuming. She has won when second-up in the past. PIWHANE and SKYTALKER are others that could be worth including.

raceTips.comment: Naralinga has a good record and has won two of his past three, the latest at Naracoorte beating Gusty Way. Skytalker is a former WA galloper who has been placed at his past four, the latest as fav at Albany. Costless comes back in class after running 4th behind You Sexy Thing on the Parks last week. Startide was OK first-up and should run well. Sunday Fun Day could improve in a race like this.
